# RightSteps

> RightSteps (App Store name "RightSteps: Sharpen Your Mind") is a free one-finger path puzzle game for iPhone by independent developer Gabriel Ross. The player drags a single route from the bottom-left corner to a flag in the top-right. Every square crossed is +1, green squares add, orange squares multiply and red squares hurt, so the order matters, and the route can never cross itself. Modes: a Daily board shared by all players with a world ranking, Campaign worlds with star targets and lives, and endless Zen. Optional purchases remove ads and add hints. Android is in closed beta.
